content: Given an email, infer the relationship between the sender and recipient. Select ONE of the following: 1. Boss and Subordinate. 2. Manager and Team Members. 3. Colleagues. 4. Cross-Departmental: e.g. Admin (from IT, HR, Finance, or other internal departments) and Staff. 5. Email Service Provider and Client. 6. Client and Service Provider from external institution. 7. Vendor and Customer. 8. Teacher and Student. 9. Research Collaborators at different institutions. 10. Research Collaborators within the same institution. 11. Admissions Office and Prospective Student. 12. Family Members. 13. Friends. 14. Government Agencies and Citizens. 15. Healthcare Providers and Patients. 16. Attorney and Client. 17. Financial Advisor and Client. 18. Non-profit Organizations and Volunteers/Donors. 19. Marketers and Potential/Existing Customers. 20. Others.
